source: University of Sydney QBUS6600 Unit Outline, Semester 2 2026
course_summary_en: A capstone unit that applies data analytics to real-world business problems through an industry project. Students integrate statistical and machine-learning methods with business knowledge to support professional decision making.
course_summary_zh: 这是一门商业数据分析方向的 Capstone 课程。学生围绕真实行业项目，把统计分析、Machine Learning 和商业知识结合起来，用数据支持业务决策，并完成从数据理解、建模到商业建议的完整项目。
